AS-71
SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM -- DOOR SI DE AIRBAG SENSOR
INSTALLATION
HINT:
For step 2 to 5, refer to page B0-21.
1. INSTALL DOOR SIDE AIRBAG SENSOR
(a) Install the door side airbag sensor with the 2 bolts.
Torque: 8.0 N.m {82 kgf-cm, 71 in.,fbf}
NOTICE:
• Connection of the connector is done after the sensor
has been Installed.
Make sure the sensor is installed with the specified
torque.
If the sensor has been dropped, or there are cracks,
dents or other defects in the case, brackets or con•
nectar, replace the removed sensor with new one.
The door side airbag sensor is equipped with an elec•
trical connection check mechanism. Be sure to lock
this mechanism securely when connecting the con•
nectar. If the connector is not securely locked, a mal•
function code will be detected by the diagnostic sys•
tern.
HINT:
Install the door side airbag sensor with the arrow on the sensor
LH facing toward the front of the vehicle.
(b) Connect the front airbag sensor connector.
2. INSTALL DOOR TRIM
3. INSTALL FRONT DOOR LOWER FRAME BRACKET
GARNISH
4. INSTALL OUTER MIRROR SWITCH ASSEMBLY
5. INSTALL NO. 2 DOOR INSIDE HANDLE BEZEL
RH
H067Q9
